# Gateway options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

29 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `Gateway`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BindAddress` | `string` | `"0.0.0.0"` | an IPv4 or IPv6 address such as 0.0.0.0, 127.0.0.1 or ::1 (host names are not resolved) | Gateway | start | Address the client listener binds. |
| `CharactersSchemaVersion` | `int` | `75` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | Gateway | start | The characters schema version this gateway advertises; defaults to the version this build targets. Explicit override only. |
| `ContentRevision` | `string` | `"world-schema-69"` | text | Gateway | start | The content revision this gateway advertises; must equal the worker's. Defaults to the revision derived from the world schema version this build targets (`GatewayManifestVersions.ContentRevisionFor`), which is what a default worker (Cluster:Worker:VersionsFromDatabase on) advertises once its database is at that version. Set it only to pin an explicit override (then set the worker's labels and Cluster:Worker:VersionsFromDatabase=false to match). |
| `LinkRetryDelay` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:01` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | First wait before reconnecting a lost or refused worker link; doubles up to 30 s. |
| `LinkSecret` | `string` | `""` | text | Gateway | start | The shared link secret (Cluster:Worker:LinkSecret on the worker): at least 16 characters, or the gateway refuses to start. |
| `LoginWorker` | `string` | `""` | text | Gateway | start | Node id of the worker new sessions open on (it must name a `Workers` entry, or `LegacyWorkerNodeId` in single-worker mode). While it is down, sessions open on the ready link with the fewest sessions. Empty, the default, designates none: sessions always spread over the ready links. |
| `MaxConnections` | `int` | `0` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | Gateway | start | Most simultaneous client connections; 0 means no cap of the gateway's own (Net:Protection still applies). |
| `MaxConnectionsPerIp` | `int` | `0` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | Gateway | start | Most simultaneous client connections from one address; 0 means no cap of the gateway's own. |
| `MaxOutboundBytes` | `long` | `8388608` | a whole number, -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807 | Gateway | start | A client whose unsent data exceeds this many bytes (it stopped reading) is disconnected (World:MaxOutboundBytes). |
| `NodeId` | `string` | `"gateway"` | text | Gateway | start | This gateway's node id in the link manifest. |
| `Port` | `int` | `8086` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | Gateway | start | Port clients connect to; the realm list must name it (realmlist address) instead of the world's World:Port. |
| `PreAuthTimeout` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:10` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | A connection that has not sent a valid CMSG_AUTH_SESSION within this time is closed (the world's World:PreAuthTimeout rule). |
| `RealmId` | `int` | `1` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | Gateway | start | Must equal the worker's Cluster:Worker:RealmId. |
| `WorkerAddress` | `string` | `"127.0.0.1"` | text | Gateway | start | Address of the world worker's gateway listener (Cluster:Worker:BindAddress). Used only while `Workers` is empty. |
| `WorkerPort` | `int` | `8095` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | Gateway | start | Port of the world worker's gateway listener (Cluster:Worker:Port). Used only while `Workers` is empty. |
| `Workers` | `List<GatewayWorkerEntry>` | `[]` | a list: numbered keys 0, 1, 2, ...; each entry is a group of keys | Gateway | start | The world workers this gateway links to, one link each (node id, address, port, optional maps). When empty, the single-worker keys `WorkerAddress` and `WorkerPort` describe one entry named `LegacyWorkerNodeId`; when set, those two keys are ignored. Every worker must accept the same `LinkSecret`, `RealmId` and manifest values. An entry may also name a standby process (StandbyNodeId, StandbyAddress, StandbyPort), the target of a whole-World handoff of that slot (needs Gateway:Handoff:Enabled). |
| `WorldSchemaVersion` | `int` | `69` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | Gateway | start | The world schema version this gateway advertises; defaults to the version this build targets. Explicit override only. |

## `Gateway:Control`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Activate` | `TimeSpan` | `00:01:00` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | Reply timeout of Activate (the target starts the retail arrival). Default 60 s. |
| `Default` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:10` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | Reply timeout of the quick verbs: Describe, Warm, StopAdmissions, Resume, ReleaseWriterLock, Retire, TargetDescribe, Reserve, Install, Discard, ResumeSource, RetireSource. Default 10 s. |
| `Flush` | `TimeSpan` | `00:01:00` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | Reply timeout of Flush (every captured save made durable). Default 60 s. |
| `Freeze` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:30` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | Reply timeout of Freeze and Suspend (the world thread plus a durable flush). Default 30 s. |
| `Promote` | `TimeSpan` | `00:02:00` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | Reply timeout of Promote (the standby takes the writer lock and runs as the active world). Default 120 s. |

## `Gateway:Handoff`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AnomalyAfter` | `TimeSpan` | `00:10:00` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | How long a handoff may stay unresolved before the gateway raises an error-severity anomaly (it keeps retrying). |
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | Gateway | start | `true` lets this gateway coordinate whole-World handoffs and finish interrupted ones from the journal: it connects to the characters database (Database:Characters:*, schema validation only, nothing is created or upgraded), keeps a control link to each slot's standby (Gateway:Workers:N:StandbyNodeId) and opens a control channel to every worker. The workers must have Cluster:Worker:Handoff:Enabled on. `false`, the default, changes nothing. |
| `RecoveryInterval` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:05` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | How often the gateway looks for unresolved handoffs in the journal and recovers them (before the epoch takeover they abort, after it they roll forward). A failing recovery backs off up to 60 s. |

## `Gateway:Transfers`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AnomalyAfter` | `TimeSpan` | `00:10:00` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | How long a player transfer may stay unresolved before the gateway raises an error-severity anomaly (it keeps retrying). Default 10 minutes. |
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | Gateway | start | `true` lets this gateway coordinate cross-worker player transfers and finish interrupted ones from the journal: it connects to the characters database (Database:Characters:*, schema validation only, nothing is created or upgraded) and opens a control channel to every worker. The workers must have Cluster:Worker:Transfers:Enabled on. `false`, the default, changes nothing. |
| `RecoveryInterval` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:05` | a time span, [d.]hh:mm:ss | Gateway | start | How often the gateway looks for unresolved player transfers in the journal and recovers them (before the commit they abort, after it they roll forward). Default 5 s. |
| `TestStageHold` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | Gateway | start | `true` lets the crash scenarios of the test suite hold a transfer at a stage they name in the process environment. Never set it on a real gateway: a held transfer waits up to 4 minutes. `false`, the default, ignores that environment. |
